// CASE dart_chunk_doc_comment expect=pass
/// Runs [operation] on at most [limit] items at a time.
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int limit,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  final width = limit;
  // for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) would run one at a time.
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map((item) => operation(item))));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_worker_doc_comment expect=pass
class Pool {
  /// Bounded helper.
  static Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
    List<T> items,
    int width,
    Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  ) async {
    final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
    var next = 0;
    await Future.wait(
      List.generate(width, (_) async {
        while (next < items.length) {
          final index = next++;
          results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
        }
      }),
    );
    return results.cast<R>();
  }
}

// CASE dart_chunk_impostor_extra expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency2<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int limit,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0, n = items.length; offset < n; offset += limit) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(limit);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map((item) => operation(item))));
  }
  return results;
}
